title: Set 269

sentences.ko: 솔직히 별로 한 게 없어. 토요일에 친구 생일 모임에 가기로 했었는데, 일곱 시쯤 소파에 누웠다가 자정까지 깨지를 않았어. 그래서 그냥 친구한테 미안하다고 문자 보내고 다시 잤어.
sentences.text: I didn't really do anything, honestly. I was supposed to go to my friend's birthday thing on Saturday, but I lay down on the couch at like seven and didn't wake up till midnight, so I just texted her sorry and went back to bed.

alts.text: Didn't do much, to be honest. Was supposed to hit my friend's birthday thing Saturday, but I crashed on the couch around seven and woke up at midnight, so I texted her sorry and went back to sleep.

To be honest, I did not do very much. I was meant to attend my friend's birthday gathering on Saturday, but I lay down on the couch at around seven and did not wake until midnight, so I sent her an apology and returned to bed.

sentences.note: **was supposed to** 는 ~하기로 했었는데 결국 못 했을 때 씁니다. 캐주얼의 **crashed on the couch** 는 소파에서 곯아떨어졌다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 또 다른 사람 주문이 왔는데, 버섯 요리가 한 판 가득이었어. 버섯만 아니었으면 괜찮았을 텐데, 내가 버섯을 진짜 싫어하거든. 앱에서는 환불해 준대. 근데 벌써 아홉 시가 다 됐는데 우리 아직 밥도 못 먹었어.
sentences.text: They brought us somebody else's order again, and it was this whole tray of mushroom stuff, which would've been fine except I can't stand mushrooms. The app says they'll refund us, but it's almost nine and we still haven't eaten.

alts.text: Got somebody else's order again, a whole tray of mushroom stuff. Would've been fine, but I hate mushrooms. App says we're getting a refund, but it's almost nine and we haven't eaten yet.

We were given another customer's order once again, an entire tray of mushroom dishes, which would have been acceptable except that I strongly dislike mushrooms. The app indicates that we will be refunded, but it is nearly nine o'clock and we have still not eaten.

sentences.note: **can't stand** 는 도저히 못 참을 만큼 싫다는 말입니다. **would've been fine** 은 사정만 아니었으면 괜찮았을 거라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 그래서 결국 귀 때문에 병원에 갔어. 일주일째 귀에서 삐 소리가 나서 뭔가 큰 병인 줄 알았거든. 근데 알고 보니 그냥 귀지였어. 의사가 2분 만에 빼 줬는데, 너무 민망했어. 그래도 이제 다 잘 들려.
sentences.text: So I finally went to the doctor about my ear, because it's been ringing for like a week and I was sure it was something bad. But it turned out to be just wax. The doctor cleaned it out in two minutes, and I felt so dumb, but I can hear everything now.

alts.text: Finally got my ear checked, 'cause it's been ringing for like a week and I figured it was something bad. Nope, just wax. Doc cleaned it out in two minutes. Felt so dumb, but I can hear everything now.

I finally saw the doctor about my ear, as it had been ringing for about a week and I was convinced it was something serious. However, it turned out to be only wax. The doctor removed it in two minutes, and I felt rather foolish, but I can now hear everything clearly.

sentences.note: **turned out to be** 는 알고 보니 ~였다는 뜻입니다. 귀에서 삐 소리가 나는 것은 **ringing** 으로 말합니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 아니, 범죄 실화 프로그램은 이제 그만 볼래. 지난번에 네가 하나 골랐을 때 나 일주일 동안 잠을 못 잤잖아. 그냥 웃긴 거 틀면 안 돼? 네가 골라도 돼. 아무도 안 죽기만 하면.
sentences.text: Okay, I'm not watching another true crime show, because last time you picked one I couldn't sleep for a week. Can we just put on something funny? You can pick, as long as nobody gets murdered.

alts.text: Nope, no more true crime, 'cause last time you picked one I couldn't sleep for a week. Can we just watch something funny? You pick, just no murders.

I would prefer not to watch another true crime program, because the last time you chose one, I was unable to sleep for a week. Could we watch something humorous instead? You are welcome to choose, provided that no one is murdered.

sentences.note: **as long as** 는 ~하기만 하면 이라는 조건입니다. TV나 영상을 트는 것은 **put on** 이라고 합니다.

sentences.ko: 여름 이후로 처음 헬스장에 다시 갔는데, 너무 무리했나 봐. 오늘 아침에 열이 나서 깼는데 온몸이 다 아파. 친구 말로는 오래 쉬다가 너무 세게 하면 그렇대. 그래서 오늘은 그냥 집에 있으려고.
sentences.text: I went back to the gym for the first time since summer, and I guess I overdid it, because I woke up this morning with a fever and everything hurts. My friend said that happens if you push too hard after a long break, so I'm just staying home today.

alts.text: First time back at the gym since summer, and I guess I went too hard, 'cause I woke up with a fever and everything hurts. My friend says that happens if you push it after a long break, so I'm staying home today.

I returned to the gym for the first time since the summer, and I believe I overexerted myself, because I woke this morning with a fever and pain throughout my body. My friend told me this can happen if one pushes too hard after a long break, so I am staying at home today.

sentences.note: **overdid it** 은 너무 무리했다는 뜻입니다. **push too hard** 도 몸을 너무 몰아붙인다는 비슷한 말입니다.

reviewed: 2번 한국어 '내가 버섯을 질색만 안 하면 그냥 먹어도 됐을 텐데'가 어색해서, 영어 순서대로 '버섯만 아니었으면 괜찮았을 텐데, 내가 버섯을 진짜 싫어하거든'으로 고침
2번 formal의 'cannot tolerate mushrooms'는 알레르기나 소화 문제처럼 읽혀서, 싫어한다는 뜻을 그대로 살린 'I strongly dislike mushrooms'로 고침
